lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with gentle highlights on the cow's snout and blocks.

value_contrast.note: Mid-key image; the white cow stands out clearly against the dark blue night.

color_palette.note: Warm orange and wood tones pop against the cool blue night sky.

composition_hierarchy.note: Cow and block tower form a strong diagonal leading line to the focal point.

shape_proportions.note: Very round, toy-like forms with a large head and simple, readable shapes.

viewpoint_depth.note: Eye-level three-quarter view with clear foreground, midground, and background layers.

edges_linework.note: Clean, shape-based rendering with minimal interior lines and no hard outlines.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, soft 3D look with clean surfaces and symbolic, non-photorealistic materials.

pose_rhythm.note: Calm, static pose with a gentle, playful energy and repeated block shapes.
